codes.label: No personal data is involved
codes.useWhen: The project holds no information that could identify a person. Set by the platform on Q-PP-13 and Q-PP-14 when the gate is "no".
codes.reasonMustSay: How you know: which data you checked.

codes.label: The system makes no decisions or predictions about people
codes.useWhen: Its outputs are about things (crops, roads, weather) and no person is judged by them.
codes.reasonMustSay: Who uses the outputs, and why no person is affected. Use carefully: a crop model's errors still fall on farmers.

codes.label: The system will not be used beyond the research study
codes.useWhen: Post-processing practices for a model that will never be deployed.
codes.reasonMustSay: What would change this, for example a plan to hand the model to a ministry.

codes.label: Does not apply to this kind of system or method
codes.useWhen: For example, no labels exist, so label quality does not apply; or the system is rule-based.
codes.reasonMustSay: What kind of system it is.

codes.label: Answered under another question
codes.useWhen: A near-duplicate already records the same practice (10.1.9).

codes.label: Other
codes.reasonMustSay: Why the practice does not apply.

codes.label: Planned for a later point in the project
codes.useWhen: The practice belongs to a later step, for example monitoring before deployment.

codes.label: Waiting for an ethics or regulatory decision
codes.useWhen: A committee or regulator must decide first.
codes.reasonMustSay: Which body, and when you applied.

codes.label: Waiting for data or data-access approval
codes.useWhen: The data, or permission to use it, has not arrived.

codes.label: Waiting for a partner or another team
codes.useWhen: Someone outside the team must act first.

codes.label: Needs money, computing or staff time the project does not have
codes.useWhen: The team knows how but cannot pay for it or staff it now.

codes.label: Needs skills or guidance the team does not have yet
codes.useWhen: The team does not yet know how. The suggestions, templates and notebooks are aimed at this case.
codes.reasonMustSay: What the team needs to learn.

codes.label: Not considered before this record
codes.useWhen: The question raised something the team had not thought about.
codes.reasonMustSay: Nothing more; this is an honest answer.

codes.label: Other
codes.reasonMustSay: Why the practice is not yet in place.
